allow: PowerShell($c = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient; try { $c.Connect\('localhost', 5432\); Write-Output "postgres:5432 OPEN" } catch { Write-Output "postgres:5432 CLOSED" } finally { $c.Close\(\) })

PowerShell($r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:5142/get-supplier-accounts' -Method Get; Write-Output "count=$\($r.data.Count\)"; $r.data | Where-Object { $_.totalPurchases -ne 0 -or $_.totalPayments -ne 0 } | Format-Table supplierId, supplierName, totalPurchases, totalPayments, balance, lastTransactionDate -AutoSize)

PowerShell(Write-Output "=== transactions ==="; \(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:5142/get-supplier-transactions?pageSize=5' -Method Get\).data | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4; Write-Output "=== payment history s1 ==="; \(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:5142/get-supplier-payment-history?supplierId=1&pageSize=5' -Method Get\) | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4)

PowerShell(Write-Output "=== branches ==="; \(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:5142/get-all-branches' -Method Get\).data.items | Format-Table id, name -AutoSize; Write-Output "=== purchase orders ==="; \(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:5142/get-all-purchase-orders?pageSize=10' -Method Get\).data | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3 -Compress)

PowerShell(Write-Output "=== product variants ==="; \(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:5142/get-all-product-variants?pageSize=5' -Method Get\).data.items | Format-Table id, sku, productName -AutoSize)

PowerShell(foreach \($id in 1,2\) { Write-Output "=== PO $id ==="; \(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:5142/get-purchase-order/$id" -Method Get\).data.lines | Format-Table id, productVariantId, orderedQuantity, unitPrice, status -AutoSize })

PowerShell(\(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:5142/get-supplier-payment-history?supplierId=1&pageSize=10' -Method Get\).data.items | Format-Table id, paymentId, invoiceNumber, amount, paymentAmount, balanceBefore, balanceAfter, invoiceTotalAmount, invoiceDueBefore, invoiceDueAfter -AutoSize)
